profile.headline: Analytical Problem Solver | System Integrator | Software Developer
profile.jobTitle: Manager, Software Development / Lead Full-Stack Developer
profile.summary:
I am an analytical problem solver with a broad range of system integration and development experience.  I enjoy learning new things and using technology to achieve business goals.

Specialties: .NET, EDI, HIPAA, Blazor, Azure, System Integration, Web Development, Information Security

Acknowledged on Microsoft's Security Researcher Page:
https://portal.msrc.microsoft.com/en-us/security-guidance/advisory/CVE-2018-8269

positions.title: Manager, Software Development / Lead Full-Stack Developer
Application Developer
positions.description: • Designed and built an internal web portal application using Blazor WASM for the front end and Azure Functions for the back end.
positions.insights: Skills: Azure Functions · Blazor · Continuous Integration (CI) · Continuous Delivery (CD) · .NET Core

positions.title: Lead Software Designer/Implementer
positions.description:
• Designed and began building a web based rating and document generation system using ASP.Net Core Web API for the backend and React.js for the frontend. The application runs on Docker and is deployed to Azure Kubernetes Service.
• Designed and built a web application to generate rates and marketing materials for small group plans using ASP.Net Core and Vue.js.
• Constructed a CI/CD pipeline to automatically build, package, and deploy web applications.
• Built an employee/group enrollment web application that significantly reduced manual data entry.
• Led integration with federal and state based health insurance exchanges in multiple states.
• Designed, built and maintained real time EDI applications supporting eligibility, benefits, and claim status using C#/SOAP/ASP.NET Web API.
• Created a web application for submitting and approving charitable grant requests, replacing a paper-based process.
• Migrated web based internal/external broker proposal system to new platform.
• Implemented a vulnerability management program to identify and remediate application and infrastructure security risks.

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst
positions.description:
• Designed and built web based internal/external broker proposal system used for all new small group proposals and quotes.
• Designed and built batch processing EDI system for inbound electronic claims and inbound/outbound electronic enrollment.
• Maintained and enhanced web applications for dentists, group administrators, and subscribers.
• SharePoint/MS Project Server development and support.

positions.title: Senior Programmer
positions.description:
• Developed websites, web applications, and multimedia based training applications for clients.
• Responsible for network, server, and desktop support and maintenance.
• Built a real estate company website integrated with the RETS platform.

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst
positions.description:
• Developed web applications for dentists, group administrators, and members.  
• Network, server, and desktop support and maintenance.

positions.title: Senior Programmer
positions.description:
• Developed websites, online games, and multimedia based training applications for clients.
• Integrated with legacy systems to provide access to customer data via a secure website.

positions.title: Instructional Designer
positions.description: Created multimedia based training software for new hires.
